gaps: Most existing clients expose raw REST methods but do not provide a terminal workflow for CAD document triage, assembly inspection, and downstream export handoff.
Glassworks is excellent for endpoint discovery and examples, but it is browser-centered and not designed for repeatable agent runs, local search, or scripted delivery.
Existing SDKs do not make Onshape document/workspace/version/element IDs easy for agents to discover and reuse across CAD-to-rendering workflows.
patterns: Onshape models are organized around document, workspace/version/microversion, and element IDs; useful CLIs must preserve that DWVME mental model.
API-key automation should support signed request headers and custom enterprise base URLs, while keeping keys in environment variables.
Export and translation workflows are central to downstream CAD interoperability with Blender, simulation tools, and manufacturing formats.

novel_features.name: CAD document triage for agents
novel_features.description: Find recent CAD documents with compact structured fields that agents can carry into follow-up workspace, element, and export calls.
novel_features.rationale: Combines Onshape document search with Printing Press field selection, compact JSON, local cache provenance, and non-interactive defaults.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this first when an agent needs to locate the right assembly or part studio without burning context on full document metadata.

novel_features.name: Workspace-aware element routing
novel_features.description: Turn an Onshape document/workspace pair into a typed map of Part Studios, assemblies, BOM tabs, blobs, and application elements.
novel_features.rationale: Onshape's DWVME URL model is powerful but hard for agents; this command turns it into a compact routing table for later CAD operations.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this after choosing a document to identify which element should feed part inspection, assembly inspection, export, or rendering.

novel_features.name: Assembly instance graph capture
novel_features.description: Fetch an assembly definition and select just the instance graph fields needed for CAD review, BOM reasoning, or downstream Blender planning.
novel_features.rationale: Raw assembly responses are nested and verbose; field selection makes the assembly graph usable inside an agent context window.
novel_features.example: onshape-pp-cli assemblies get --did 3cb6ad4256bb099a0e4813ab --wvm w --wvmid b3fe484986a689a317b7259b --eid f22782a9f60e037e2f4d7c39 --agent --select rootAssembly.instances.id,rootAssembly.instances.name
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent needs to understand assembly composition before exporting geometry or planning an animation/rendering scene.

novel_features.name: Part studio inventory for export decisions
novel_features.description: List part IDs and names from a Part Studio so an agent can choose export targets without opening Onshape manually.
novel_features.rationale: Part IDs are the bridge between Onshape design structure and translation/export endpoints; the CLI makes them scriptable.
novel_features.example: onshape-pp-cli parts list --did 3cb6ad4256bb099a0e4813ab --wvm w --wvmid b3fe484986a689a317b7259b --eid 1753f0a84436bf2bc39d6da6 --agent --select name,partId
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before exporting a single component to Blender, CAM, simulation, or a rendering pipeline.

novel_features.name: Offline CAD archive and search
novel_features.description: Hydrate a local SQLite mirror so agents can search and analyze previously seen Onshape data without repeated live API calls.
novel_features.rationale: Onshape is cloud-native; local sync gives agents memory across document searches, element lookups, and workflow runs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this when an agent will work across many CAD documents or needs resilient offline search during a longer design/review session.

narrative.headline: Cloud CAD inspection for agents: discover documents, route through DWVME IDs, inspect assemblies and parts, and prepare geometry for export workflows.
narrative.value_prop: Onshape is unusually strong for API-driven CAD: the Developer Portal explains the document model, Glassworks exposes the live endpoint catalog, and API keys support repeatable automation. This CLI turns that into an agent-friendly terminal workflow for CAD assemblies, part studios, geometry export, and future Blender/rendering handoff.
narrative.auth_narrative: Onshape automation can use API keys for personal/internal tools. This CLI reads ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY and ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY, also accepting the user's ONSHAPE_API_ACCESSKEY and ONSHAPE_API_SECRETKEY aliases, and signs requests with Onshape's request-signature headers.

quickstart.comment: Confirm config, key presence, and API reachability before touching CAD data.
Find the likely CAD document while keeping output small.
Route from the document/workspace to Part Studios, assemblies, BOMs, blobs, and application tabs.

quickstart.command: onshape-pp-cli assemblies get --did 3cb6ad4256bb099a0e4813ab --wvm w --wvmid b3fe484986a689a317b7259b --eid f22782a9f60e037e2f4d7c39 --agent --select rootAssembly.instances.id,rootAssembly.instances.name
quickstart.comment: Inspect assembly instances before export or rendering.

troubleshoots.symptom: Commands say auth is missing even though API keys are available
troubleshoots.fix: Export ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY and ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY, or use the accepted aliases ONSHAPE_API_ACCESSKEY and ONSHAPE_API_SECRETKEY.

troubleshoots.symptom: A document ID works in the browser but element calls fail
troubleshoots.fix: Run `workspaces list` or `versions list`, then pass the matching `--wvm` and `--wvmid`; Onshape URLs distinguish workspaces, versions, and microversions.

troubleshoots.symptom: Assembly or part output is too large for an agent
troubleshoots.fix: Add `--agent --select` with dotted fields such as `rootAssembly.instances.id,rootAssembly.instances.name` or `name,partId`.

troubleshoots.symptom: Enterprise stack keys fail on cad.onshape.com
troubleshoots.fix: Set ONSHAPE_BASE_URL to the matching enterprise API base URL, for example `https://companyName.onshape.com/api/v6`.

narrative.when_to_use: Use the Onshape CLI when an agent needs to inspect cloud CAD documents, assemblies, parts, versions, and export targets without opening a browser. It is especially useful before downstream Blender rendering, animation, simulation, or manufacturing workflows because it turns Onshape IDs and geometry structure into compact, scriptable JSON.
